name: Konstantin Mehl
headline: Founder & CEO I Daneel
location: New York, United States of America
major: Technology and Management oriented Business Administration
summary:
Daneel is the QoE firm built for roll-ups. We combine in-house CPAs with a software platform that ingests directly from common accounting systems, verifies 100% of the general ledger (not the 5% sample legacy firms rely on), and produces buyer-ready outputs where the analysis, the Excel and the slides all reconcile.

We work with VC and PE-backed roll-up operators across the full deal lifecycle: from LOI to QoE through SPA/EPA negotiation support, post-close true-ups and earn-out management. Every engagement includes advanced data cuts like WIP aging and deferred revenue analysis, COA remapping so every add-on reports the same way post-close, and a deal-specific AI that can search across all source data in minutes. 

I previously co-founded Kaia Health (sold to Sword Health for $285m) and Foodora (scaled to 5,000 employees, sold to Delivery Hero). I built Daneel to solve the financial diligence problems I experienced firsthand across both sides of the table.

positions.description:
Daneel modernizes Quality of Earnings for roll-ups by combining CPA rigor with software speed, ingesting data directly from common accounting systems, delivering 100% GL verification across 110+ adjustment categories, and producing buyer-ready outputs with built-in SPA/EPA positions where the Excel ties to the slides. Every engagement includes advanced data cuts like WIP aging and deferred revenue analysis that most operators lack today, plus COA remapping so every add-on reports the same way post-close.

We support the full deal lifecycle, from LOI to QoE through SPA/EPA negotiation support, post-close true-ups, earn-out management, and continuous QoE monitoring. For operators doing volume, our Roll-up Brain lets you compare deal terms and performance metrics across all targets in real time, turning acquisitions from bespoke projects into a repeatable pipeline.
